errors.text_span: и приходите от продажби на дребно
errors.evidence: The description invents the category "приходите от продажби на дребно" (revenue from retail sales). The legend clearly states the second series is "Ръст" (Growth), which is a percentage.

errors.text_span: с начална стойност 0 и крайна стойност 2023
errors.evidence: The X-axis represents discrete years from 2017 to 2023. It is not a continuous numerical scale starting from 0.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е означена с "Обобщени данни (в трил. долара)" и "Ръст (%)".
errors.evidence: The Y-axis has no label. The text mistakes the legend entries for the Y-axis label.

errors.text_span: Стойностите на Оста Y се показват на интервали от 2 долара.
errors.evidence: The Y-axis tick marks are at intervals of 5.00 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25), not 2.

errors.text_span: Стойностите на графиката за първата линия варират от 0 до 25,00, а тези на втората линия варират от 0 до 25,00.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly states that the data range for both series is the same as the Y-axis range (0 to 25.00). The actual data range for the first series is 9.50 to 20.70, and for the second series is 7% to 19%.

errors.text_span: Първата линия, обозначена като "Обобщени данни", е със син цвят и изглежда като плътна линия.
errors.evidence: The blue data series is an area chart, not a line chart.

errors.text_span: Тя започва от 0 на оста Y през 2017
errors.evidence: The first data series ("Обобщени данни") starts at a value of 9.50 in 2017, not 0.
The value for the first series in 2023 is 20.70, not 20.00.

errors.text_span: Линията показва постепенно нарастване от 13% през 2017 до 20% през 2023.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly attributes percentage values to the first series ("Обобщени данни"), which is measured in trillion dollars. The percentages belong to the second series ("Ръст").

errors.text_span: Тя започва от 0 на оста Y през 2017
errors.evidence: The second series ("Ръст") does not have a data point for 2017, and it certainly does not start at 0. Its first data point is 14% in 2018.
The value for the "Ръст" series in 2023 is 7%, not 19%. The value for 2022 is 19%.

errors.text_span: Линията показва постепенно нарастване от 12,20% през 2017 до 20,70% през 2023.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly assigns the trillion dollar values from the first series (e.g., 12.20, 20.70) to the second series ("Ръст") and mislabels them as percentages.
